items.prompt: What must change before using this report as evidence about independent-arrival production latency?
items.modelAnswer: Define representative independent/scheduled arrivals with original timestamps/lag, rates/bursts/concurrency and rejected/timed-out work; measure enough duration/samples on appropriate controlled hardware/build with actual service boundaries/errors. Add required cancellation/failure/durable protocols separately. Keep current local backpressured observations as their own limited evidence, not renamed production metrics.

criteria.text: Does not convert toy success into production/recovery/SLO proof.
